entry_state: The operation registry preserves effects and closed record boundaries. Ordered EPS retains context, series completeness and exact comparison traces; company projection checks full books and daily share history without committing. The grammar appendix is next.
exit_state: The preserved grammar distinguishes parsing, semantic validation and posting; same-currency typing and maximal-rule selection preserve explicit failure states. Conditional requests do not supply probabilities. Appendix C begins with the scope of the source collection and its inspected-support table continues.
findings: The Core 0 grammar remains a preserved teaching frontend; a successful parse does not establish semantic validity or enlarge the portable profile.
Historical schemas and new versioned portable records retain different authority; structural validation does not establish accounting treatment or reference-kind correctness.
Same-currency addition requires separate context checks; family truth requires nonempty feasibility and does not turn solver uncertainty into a Boolean or probability.
Rule selection uses maximal applicable rules under an acyclic override graph, with unsupported and conflicting outcomes retained.
The two-condition run returns separate interest, cash and equity results; the symbolic interval and representative case do not establish an unconditional mean.
Appendix C qualifies the initial 32-paper catalogue and begins a source-specific technical-support table; that section remains open.
